snippet.title: Glintland - Gameplay Trailer Q3 2025 - English | Run-Based Factory Builder | Fantasy World
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO NOW!

Rebuild Glintland, one tile at a time!
Step into the shoes of a master craftsman at the Nightstone Academy, where you'll forge legendary items, build intricate factory systems, and restore harmony to a land shrouded in mystery. In Glintland, a relaxing tile-based factory-building puzzle game, your creativity and strategy are key to reviving a world once filled with light and wonder.

💡 Place tiles, optimize your production lines, and discover the secrets behind the mysterious darkness that engulfed the land. Whether you're a casual gamer or a strategy enthusiast, Glintland offers a unique mix of relaxation and challenge.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974040/Glintland?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=2025_Q3&utm_medium=web&utm_content=video_gameplay_q3_en&utm_term=video
🌐 Website: https://itengy.games/game/glintland/
📘 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/glintland

✨ Created by Kris F. Lipphart
🎨 Copyright 2025 itengy Games
